text:
maria-cs: Hey team — customer (tenant: acme-inc / id: t-4821) hit 403s on generation after an SSO provisioning sync a few hours ago. They say nothing changed on their side. Can we triage?

maria-cs: TLDR: POST /v1/generate -> 403 {\"error\":\"missing required scope: inference.generate\"} but their service key was provisioned by our SSO flow.

tom-infra: Can you paste the request_id and a minimal repro (curl) + the token header (redacted)?

maria-cs: request_id: r-0a9c3f7b. Repro (customer):
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \ 
  -H \"Authorization: Bearer sk_live_xxxREDACTEDxxx\" \ 
  -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" \ 
  -d '{\"model\":\"gpt-open-8k\",\"input\":\"hello\"}'
```
Response: 403 / body:
```json
{\"error\":{\"type\":\"authorization_error\",\"message\":\"missing required scope: inference.generate\",\"request_id\":\"r-0a9c3f7b\"}}
```

eli-se: Can you fetch the token introspection / key metadata? Does the provisioner actually include generate in the scopes claim?

maria-cs: Yep, pulled the key manifest from our control plane for sk_live_xxxREDACTEDxxx: 
```json
{\"key_id\":\"k-7a2\",\"scopes\":[\"embeddings.create\",\"rerank.execute\"],\"created_by\":\"sso:acme-inc\",\"created_at\":\"2026-02-11T15:02:03Z\"}
```
Note: inference.generate is missing. The customer says the provisioner should have given [inference.generate, embeddings.create, rerank.execute].

sam-platform: Interesting — looks like the last scope was dropped. I recently pushed a change to the bulk-provisioner parser for CSV-ish SCIM inputs to normalize separators (space/semicolon/comma). There's a known edge with trailing newline + no delimiter that can drop the final token if the string ends with a null/trailing CR. I'll repro locally.

sam-platform: Repro steps I ran:
```bash
# simulate SCIM bulk row that previously caused drop
echo -n \"inference.generate,embeddings.create,rerank.execute\n\" > /tmp/row
cat /tmp/row | ./provisioner/bin/parse-scopes --mode=bulk
# previous version returned [inference.generate,embeddings.create]
# current fix: trims trailing control chars before split
```

jess-ops: Customer impact: affects newly provisioned/rotated keys during the SSO sync window (approx 14:50-16:10 PST). Existing keys that were created prior are OK. Suggested immediate mitigation: create a one-off service key for them with the full scopes and tell them to swap it in; i'll prepare the support email.

maria-cs: Customer said they can rotate to a new key if we provide it. They are blocked in production until we do.

sam-platform: I'll open an eng ticket and roll a patch to the provisioner to strip control characters before splitting on delimiters. Also will run a short backfill job to re-check keys created in that window and reapply missing scopes (only for keys provisioned by SSO bulk flow).

infra-bot: Incident created: INC-2026 — provisioner-scope-truncate. Priority: P2. Assignee: sam-platform.

sam-platform: Patch plan: 1) hotfix to provisioner to normalize scope string and add defensive tests, 2) dry-run backfill that compares stored raw claim vs parsed scopes, 3) if mismatch, reprovision key scopes via control-plane API (audit log), 4) run smoke tests against generate/embeddings endpoints.

jess-ops: I'll send the temporary key to the customer and mark as \"do not use long-term\". Also adding runbook note so CS can create temp keys for similar ones until patch lands.

eli-se: For troubleshooting checklist: always inspect key manifest in control plane, check raw JWT claim (scopes/entitlements) and request logs (request_id) to confirm server-side 403 reason. If root cause is provisioner, avoid rotating keys until we confirm backfill.

maria-cs: Thanks — i'll update the customer and confirm when they swap. Will report back here.

sam-platform: ETA to hotfix + backfill dry-run: ~3 hours. Will post updates.

maria-cs: update: customer accepted temp key and swapped; generation calls passed on their side. Closing customer blocker pending infra fix.

jess-ops: filing follow-up doc for the playbook and adding a short postmortem once backfill completes.

sam-platform: Patch merged to main, running canary for 30m, then schedule backfill during low-traffic window.

maria-cs: closing ticket with customer. Will reopen if anything else pops up.
